descriptions.text: CondomSOL on Solana has exited, and its Twitter account is no longer accessible. The wallet associated with CondomSOL raised 4,965 SOL, equivalent to approximately $922,000.

Condom Crypto, a Solana memecoin, was the subject of an exit scam in early April 2024. The team raised 4,965 SOL (valued at ~$906,000) in a presale and then disappeared, deleting all online channels. No tokens were distributed and no technical exploit or recovery action was recorded. Condom Crypto's loss was a planned team exit scam following its presale ICO on Solana. Funds were sent directly to team-controlled wallets, with no enforced escrow or automated distribution. The team abandoned the project and absconded with all raised assets, and there was no technical vulnerability or contract exploit involved.
